r04_static_trace: An attached notification page reaches owner completion with _needsTaskReconcile=true.
The page sets _needsTaskReconcile=false and _reconcilingTask=true, then calls real readDeviceInfo.
_runExclusive sets _isUpgrading.value=true before _ownerEpoch++. GetX 4.7.2 delivers the busy event synchronously.
taskDeviceAddress still matches the old key/epoch; _attachCurrentTask sets _needsTaskReconcile=true again.
The identity read finishes; its idle notification tries to reconcile but returns because _reconcilingTask is still true.
The outer finally clears only _reconcilingTask. _needsTaskReconcile remains true and _deviceReady stays false.
r04_repair_direction: Initialize/invalidate the owner generation before publishing observable busy state, and prevent a page's own identity reconciliation from reattaching/rearming a completed task. Retain the synchronous exclusive lock, exact target binding and identity-gated actions.
r04_next_oracle: Use real OtaService plus the existing fake BLE, or a fixture preserving actual synchronous busy/epoch transitions. For completed/cancelled/failed tasks, require one exact-target GET_INFO, no extra BEGIN, no stuck/looped reconciliation and enabled actions only after successful identity verification; retain wrong-device and failed-identity negative cases.
